comment: Deliberate: an app allowed to sign in without PKCE must send a nonce (RFC 9700 section 2.1.1), and this module sends neither.
Deliberate: userinfo takes the access token in the Authorization header only; RFC 6750 section 2.2 says the form body SHOULD NOT be used.
acr_values and the acr claim aren't supported.
Deliberate: the claims parameter only picks among claims the granted scopes release, so asking for name with only openid releases nothing more.
